# A reserved _logos_ import alias is rejected in .lgo, which keeps the
# lowered helper-alias namespace collision-free (T-0.3, T-203.2).
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
cd m
! logos build ./...
stderr 'correctness::reserved_identifier'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ri

go 1.27

-- m/m/m.lgo --
package m

import _logos_rt "logos/rt"

var _ = _logos_rt.MustNonNil
